text.autoconfig.abadoned_greatwork.title: Abadoned Greatwork
text.autoconfig.abadoned_greatwork.optio: When enabled, the Eye of Locating sends its direction and the found target position to the summoner once it has found and turned toward the target.
text.abadoned_greatwork.eye.tooltip: Right-click to throw it; it hunts for its target and returns as an item if it fails
text.abadoned_greatwork.crystal.length_e: Error: spell list length exceeds crystal limit (%s)!
text.abadoned_greatwork.crystal.no_input: Error: crystal has no input data!
text.abadoned_greatwork.crystal.no_outpu: Error: crystal has no output data!
text.abadoned_greatwork.crystal.wrong: Verification failed: stack result does not match expected output!
text.abadoned_greatwork.crystal.success_: Phew, looks like I've gotten quite good at this.
text.abadoned_greatwork.riddles.add: Start with the simple, master addition and subtraction.
text.abadoned_greatwork.riddles.add.long: Submit a list of patterns that performs addition.
text.abadoned_greatwork.riddles.bigger: Given two numbers, find the larger.
text.abadoned_greatwork.riddles.bigger.l: Submit a list of patterns that takes two numbers, compares them, and returns the larger one.
text.abadoned_greatwork.riddles.block: Knowing the center, discern all eight directions.
text.abadoned_greatwork.riddles.block.lo: Submit a list of patterns that takes a position vector and returns a list of the eight adjacent vectors on the same horizontal plane (parallel to XZ) plus the vector itself, all floored, sorted with Themistian Purification.
text.abadoned_greatwork.riddles.block_cu: Through all six directions, seek the twenty-seven points of the cube.
Submit a list of patterns that takes a position vector and returns all 27 coordinates in a cube of edge length 3 centered on it, all floored, sorted with Themistian Purification.
text.abadoned_greatwork.riddles.cross: As the right-hand rule dictates, the logic of the cross product.
text.abadoned_greatwork.riddles.cross.lo: Submit a pattern or list of patterns that performs cross product, a fundamental vector operation.
text.abadoned_greatwork.riddles.absolute: Know this and that, know the distance between.
Submit a list of patterns that takes two position vectors and returns the distance between them.
text.abadoned_greatwork.riddles.mix: Three edges complete, three dimensions whole.
text.abadoned_greatwork.riddles.mix.long: Submit a list of patterns that takes three vectors and returns their scalar triple product — the volume of the parallelepiped they span, as a positive value.
hexcasting.page.abandoned_greatwork.1: The ancients left behind, and those who come after follow. I am neither the first Hex Caster, nor will I be the last.$(br2)Across the world, ruins left by ancient Hex Casters are scattered about. Though abandoned and cast into the mundane world, these structures still reflect the glory and brilliance they once held as Greatworks.
hexcasting.page.abandoned_greatwork.2: It seems the Hex Casters of old also created a special material to test the skill of their apprentices. Those who passed the trial would receive a reward.$(br2)Unfortunately, my records on this are not yet detailed enough. I should conduct more in-depth research when the opportunity arises.
advancements.abadoned_greatwork.root.des: Explore ruins left by ancient hexcasters
advancements.abadoned_greatwork.attempt_: Try to solve a Truth Crystal puzzle
advancements.abadoned_greatwork.solve_pu: Successfully pass a Truth Crystal verification
advancements.abadoned_greatwork.visit_ru: Discover a Ruined Circle structure in the Overworld
Discover a Ruined Circle structure in the Nether
Discover a Ruined Circle structure in the Deep Dark
abadoned_greatwork.category.text.desc: The glory of ages past now lies in ruin — today's works shall share this fate.
hexcasting.page.truth_crystal.1: One of the relics left by ancient hexcasters is the $(l)Truth Crystal$(). These mysterious crystals appear to have been used as testing tools — designed to evaluate the skill of an apprentice by challenging them to produce specific spell patterns.$(br2)A Truth Crystal contains a riddle with a description, and a length limit for submitted patterns. The aspiring hexcaster must solve the riddle to discover the correct pattern list.
hexcasting.page.truth_crystal.3: To attempt a riddle, place the Truth Crystal into a $(l)Truth Crystal Base$(), then right-click the base while holding an Iota-containing item. The crystal will evaluate your spell and judge the result.$(br2)If successful, the crystal will be consumed and a reward will be granted from a loot table specific to that crystal.
hexcasting.page.truth_crystal.crafting: Knowledge lies buried in history, wisdom cast aside in the dust of ages.
hexcasting.page.truth_crystal_patterns.c: Crystal Gazing requires a $(l)Truth Crystal$() held in the offhand. It consumes no media and displays the detailed information stored within the crystal in chat. Takes no input and produces no output.
hexcasting.page.truth_crystal_patterns.s: Truth Crystals demand strict output ordering. This pattern takes a list, rearranges its elements according to an intrinsic ordering, and returns the sorted list.
hexcasting.page.locator_patterns.eye_of_: An Eye of Locating, thrown like an Eye of Ender, flies a short distance, then hovers and searches the surroundings. If it senses the target biome or structure nearby, it turns to face it. After a while it shatters — or, more often, drops back as an item still bearing its target, ready to be thrown again.
hexcasting.page.locator_patterns.locate: Locate: takes a $(l)Biome Token$() (a ResourceLocation wrapping a biome or structure), seeks its nearest occurrence across the wide world, and returns its position vector. Misfortune strikes if none can be found.
hexcasting.page.locator_patterns.random_: Random Target: consumes nothing; with equal odds it picks a random biome or a random structure, returning it wrapped as a $(l)Biome Token$(). Paired with Locate, it begins a journey of serendipity.
hexcasting.page.locator_patterns.current: Current Whereabouts: consumes nothing and returns a $(l)Biome Token$() of the biome the caster currently stands in. Fails upon unnamed lands.
hexcasting.page.hex_eyes.tracking_item: An $(l)Eye of Tracking$() hovers near a chosen creature and follows it wherever it goes, like a patient vulture. It never shatters on its own — it simply keeps watch until its target is gone.
hexcasting.page.hex_eyes.waypoint_item: An $(l)Eye of Waypoint$() flies to a chosen place and hovers there, marking the spot. Once it arrives it lingers a while, then breaks with a burst of light.
hexcasting.page.hex_eyes.tracking_eye: Summon Tracking Eye: takes a $(l)vector$() for the summon position and an $(l)entity$() to track; summons an $(l)Eye of Tracking$() at that position, relentlessly following the creature.
hexcasting.page.hex_eyes.waypoint_eye: Summon Waypoint Eye: takes a $(l)vector$() for the summon position and a $(l)vector$() destination; summons an $(l)Eye of Waypoint$() at that position, which flies to the destination.
